title: Story premise EDU072: The Pollinator Has More Than One Stop
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (environment/ecology). Hook: Where did this visitor come from before reaching your flower? Takeaway/theme: Pollination can be understood as interactions among organisms over space and time.
description: A gardener wants to understand why one flowering plant gets visits, but watches only that plant and misses the network around it. Following a reviewed example pollinator between flowers reveals interacting needs and timing.
